reviews.comment: This class was set up as groups where every Tuesday you would take a very hard test over different chapters individually and then as a group. The mean on the individual tests was about a 40% and as a group it was about 70%. The RATs would take up a majority of your grade. And the midterm and final are set up the same awful way. DO NOT RECOMMEND.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.
